description: Publish or unpublish a url an outside caller may POST to run an approved script. Publish mints the bearer secret and returns it once; the same caller again rotates it. Unpublish deletes both.

op.description: publish: write the route record and mint the caller's secret. unpublish: delete both.

path.description: The url path under /hooks/, e.g. 'customers/upsert'. Lowercase, digits, _ - and /.

script.description: publish only, required there: an approved script the hook runs, e.g. 'upsert_customer_contact.py'.

caller.description: publish only, required there: who this hook is for, e.g. 'bff' or 'acme'. Names the secret (HOOK_TOKEN_<CALLER>).

params.description: publish only: arguments fixed by the publisher. Baked in last, so a caller cannot override them.
